title: Independent live coverage, pick navigation, mobile, and identity review
scope: Evidence and coordination only. No shared match data, probabilities, picks, aliases, collectors, builders, styles, or workflows were modified.
method: Compared the public Hotspawn CS2 lobby and fixture API with the latest successful Pages workflow annotations and the published JSON/pages. Replayed the selected pick inputs from the public originated JSON where available. Checked the named match against Hotspawn, HLTV, the Polymarket contract, and independent event/roster records. Audited the summary-to-picks and unresolved links and ran a local build/source validation against the checked-in repository snapshot.

identity_review.status: same-roster and fixture continuity are supported, but the Alianza market identity remains unconfirmed for safe alias-based publication

facts.detail: Hotspawn fixture 1082837 and HLTV match 2399865 both label the CCT South America Series 7 round-5 BO3 at 2026-10-21 22:00Z as Zetta vs LOS NINOS. HLTV lists the Zetta five as Notjuanjo, zockie, BabyRage, Antuanette, and Slayerhz. Hotspawn lists Antuanette, Slayerhz, zock, babyrage, and Notjuanjo (zock/zockie spelling differs).

Polymarket Gamma event 1227336 and the Polymarket page label the same advertised 22:00Z CCT round-5 BO3 as Alianza Lima Esports vs Los Niños. The contract text allows minor name differences only when the intended participant is clearly and uniquely identified; it says the market resolves 50-50 if the label could reasonably refer to another team in the same competition and intended identity is not unambiguous. The Gamma event lists a Polymarket resolution source and the market metadata points to HLTV for the series market.

facts.status: roster continuity supported, organization change not established
facts.detail: bo3.gg's current Alianza match page assigns the same five names (zockie, Slayerhz, NotJuanjo, BabyRage, Antuanette) to Alianza. Secondary records also use Alianza for earlier CCT fixtures. Zetta Games' own 2026-04-28 CS2 launch post identifies Zetta and an earlier roster but does not announce an Alianza acquisition or rebrand. No first-party Alianza/CCT statement explicitly confirming that change was located in the sources searched.

Strafe's CCT Series 7 event page lists both Alianza Lima Esports and Zetta among the event standings/participants. Strafe is secondary evidence, not an official participant register; this observation raises an identity question but does not settle it.

The 20:52Z public originated JSON now displays LOS NINOS at 79.0% from Polymarket/Kalshi consensus quotes observed at 20:53:11Z and 20:53:12Z. The earlier 20:20Z snapshot displayed 60.9%; the intervening move is a market-price change, not evidence that Alianza Lima Esports is Zetta. Independent direct market API/book checks reproduce the latest quotes. The remaining blocker is identity/contract adjudication, not quote provenance or Hotspawn popularity; this audit does not endorse the alias-dependent estimate.

At approximately 20:24Z, Polymarket Gamma market 6001634 returned the exact Alianza Lima Esports vs Los Niños match-winner market (active, accepting orders, start 22:00Z). Its CLOB books returned Alianza best bid/ask 0.38/0.39 and Los Niños 0.61/0.62 at book timestamp 2026-10-21T20:24:06.667Z. The official Kalshi event API returned two active mutually exclusive outcome markets; at retrieval, Alianza yes bid/ask was 0.35/0.43 and Los Ninos 0.57/0.65. These later Kalshi quotes differ from the 20:20 captured pair, consistent with price movement. The two source inputs in the 20:20 public JSON replay to its 60.9% consensus; no replacement number was calculated.

facts.status: latest primary-source quote replay; identity remains separate
facts.detail: The successful 20:52:48Z public snapshot (generated 20:52:58Z; origination 20:53:09Z) publishes Zetta–LOS NINOS at 20.980769%/79.019231% (pick LOS NINOS 79.0%). Its Polymarket quote is 23.5%/76.5% (bid 0.23/0.76, ask 0.24/0.77) observed 20:53:11Z; its Kalshi quote is 18.461538%/81.538462% (bid 0.16/0.78, ask 0.20/0.81) observed 20:53:12Z. At the later direct check, Polymarket CLOB books carried the same best levels at 2026-10-21T20:57:46.567Z, and Kalshi’s official event API returned both outcome markets active at the same bid/ask levels. The market names still say Alianza Lima Esports vs Los Niños/Los Ninos, not Zetta. Quote replay verifies the inputs and consensus arithmetic, not the alias identity.

published_quotes.replay: Direct Gamma market lookup and both direct CLOB book requests at the later ~20:24Z check confirmed the same top-of-book levels.

The official Kalshi event endpoint later returned two active markets with updated yes bid/ask values (Alianza 0.35/0.43; Los Ninos 0.57/0.65), confirming the source pair but not the exact old quotes; price movement is expected.

market_quote_replay.calculation_note: The displayed probabilities are the mean of the two normalized independent market estimates at their recorded 20:20 observation times; the published LOS NINOS value is 60.904639% rounded to 60.9%. This mathematical replay does not settle market-team identity.

latest_public_pick.warning: Do not treat the alias-dependent estimate as identity-adjudicated; public page labels the estimate historical/unverified for current use.

latest_market_quote_replay.calculation_note: The published probabilities are the median consensus (arithmetic median for two inputs) of the two normalized independent market estimates. This reproduces 20.980769%/79.019231%. The earlier 20:20Z consensus was 39.095361%/60.904639%; the movement is price movement only and does not establish the team alias.
